conditions: User is on the shop page
User clicks the globe icon in the top bar
User selects a language different from the current one (e.g. Deutsch)
items.expected: Shop labels and navigation text change to the selected language

conditions: User has selected a non-default language (e.g. Deutsch)
items.expected: Language selector still shows the chosen language after reload; shop labels remain in the chosen language

conditions: User selects a language from the globe menu (e.g. Deutsch)
The document's lang attribute is inspected before and after selection
items.expected: The globe menu closes and the chosen language is active; the document's lang attribute reflects the newly selected language code (e.g. 'de')

conditions: User is on the shop home page
axe-core scans the language selector area with rules wcag2a and wcag2aa
items.expected: No accessibility violations reported by axe-core for the language selector

excluded.reason: Language selection is a UI preference with no account data, authentication or access-control implication; no security test is warranted by the story or its context
No resolved bugs touch this story's language-selection behaviour; nothing to confirm
Order tracking showing any order to anyone is a SCRUM-27 concern (order history), not related to language selection in SCRUM-26
Session token surviving logout is an authentication/session concern unrelated to the language preference feature in SCRUM-26
